title: Sanctions GKG share -> GLD safe-haven bid
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] GDELT sanctions GKG share 20d z-score > 1.5 leads GLD log returns higher by 1-3 days (+), safe-haven bid rather than EM selloff; trade long GLD 3d [gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share -> finance.GLD.log_return] (parent: R2-0078)

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long GLD next session

trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
